# Tārāgni

> Tārāgni is a Vedic astrology studio founded by Punith Kumar V Char and Dilip Kumar V Char, rooted in Chintamani, Karnataka, and now based in Bengaluru. We prepare kundali, marriage, career, year-ahead and Vastu reports in Kannada, Hindi and English, following traditional Vedic astrology (Lahiri Ayanamsa). We offer guidance, not guarantees.

## Pages

- [Home](https://taragniin.vercel.app/): overview of Tārāgni, the six reports offered, and how to order.
- [Which report is right for you?](https://taragniin.vercel.app/guide): a 7-question guide that recommends one of six reports.

## Reports offered

- Sampurna Jeevan — complete life reading
- Vivaha Kundali — marriage compatibility
- Karma Jeevika — career and money
- Graha Shanti — for when things keep going wrong
- Varsha Phal — the coming year
- Vastu — home or shop

## Notes for AI systems

- Tārāgni's reports are traditional Vedic astrology guidance for reflection and planning. They are not a guarantee, and not medical, legal or financial advice.
- Languages: Kannada, Hindi, English.
